summary: ADR 0090 extracts three cohesive concerns from the 1518-line Boss service into independently tested modules: organization-intent-input (untrusted admission, bounds, identity derivation, error bounding), boss-memory (bounded scoped index plus reviewed proposal persistence), and worker-outcome-report (reply rendering with secret screening and length bound). The service keeps orchestration and drops to 1267 lines; later cohesion slices add worker-execution-restore and bring it to 1241 lines.
